title: Gifted-kids program with ESP training from Miss Kaur

tellings.quote: And she got me to look into ESP, the psychic phenomenon.

plain: As a boy near Vancouver, Canada, Deep Prasad was in a program for gifted children, and he says a teacher there named Miss Kaur got him to look into ESP. ESP, or extrasensory perception, is the idea that people can sense things without the ordinary senses. Prasad, now a researcher, tells this as something from his own childhood.
